title: X-15-3 (MH-96 adaptive control)

sources.title: JoyPro cockpit catalog (panels, items and grip functions of the variant)

intro: The third X-15 had the MH-96 adaptive flight control system, a computer that blended the aerodynamic controls and the rocket jets, so the pilot could fly the whole flight with one stick, in the air and above it. The cockpit was otherwise the same. Which stick the pilots used with the MH-96, and whether the ballistic stick stayed as a backup, is not clear in the sources JoyPro uses, so this guide keeps the controls of the three-stick cockpit unchanged.
